# mimecast_delivery_route_definition (Resource)

Manage a Mimecast Cloud Gateway delivery route definition.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mimecast_delivery_route_definition" "primary" {
  description = "tf-example-primary-route"
  hostname    = "mail.example.com"
  port        = 25
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Definition description.
- `hostname` (String) Public hostname or IP address of the email server.
- `port` (Number) Port to connect on.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `alternate_route_id` (String) Alternate delivery route definition ID.
- `auth_mechanisms` (List of String) SMTP authentication mechanisms in preferred order.
- `domain` (String) SMTP authentication domain.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) SMTP authentication password. Write-only; pair with password_wo_version to send updates.
- `password_wo_version` (Number) Version trigger for password_wo. Increment this when changing the write-only password.
- `username` (String) SMTP authentication username.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Mimecast delivery route definition ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mimecast_delivery_route_definition.primary definition-id
```
